scripts.description: Executable Morgana-native simulation of Windows Registry. Upstream executable or build output has not yet been pinned, licensed, hashed, and approved for Camelot redistribution.
scripts.command: Write-Output '[START] CTID simulation T1003'; $simulationRoot = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'Morgana\CTID'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $simulationRoot -Force | Out-Null; $artifactPath = Join-Path $simulationRoot 'CTID-001-t1003.txt'; $runKey = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'; New-ItemProperty -Path $runKey -Name 'MorganaCTIDSimulation' -Value 'cmd.exe /c exit 0' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null; Get-ItemProperty $runKey -Name 'MorganaCTIDSimulation'; Write-Output '[SUCCESS] CTID simulation T1003 family=persistence';
